quotes.text:
FLATPAK_BRANCH:
                by-project:
                    comm-(release|esr.*): stable
                    default: beta
            APP_ID:
                by-project:
                    comm-esr.*: org.mozilla.thunderbird_esr
                    default: org.mozilla.thunderbird

VERSION_FLAG:
                by-project:
                    comm-esr.*: "--esr"
                    comm-beta: "--beta"
                    default: ''
            MANIFEST_URL: "{config_params[comm_head_repository]}/file/{config_params[comm_head_rev]}/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh"
            RELEASE_NOTES_URL:
                by-project:
                    comm-esr.*: "https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/{config_params[app_version]}esr/releasenotes/"
                    comm-beta: "https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/{config_params[app_version]}beta/releasenotes/"
                    default: "https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/{config_params[app_version]}/releasenotes/"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 660 adds esr to the Flatpak ESR release-note URL. Current keyed configuration uses an esr suffix for comm-esr.*, a beta suffix for comm-beta and no suffix for the default release route. Stable/beta Flatpak branch selection is a separate keyed value. Build metadata and a packaging channel are not sufficient to derive a release-note URL by blindly appending beta. The static config was inspected; remote release-note pages and a Flatpak package were not checked.
title: Use ESR, beta and release URL suffixes explicitly
